fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-03-22 (night, 01:00): Jewellery kept in a cupboard valued at around Rs. 85,000 was found missing from a premises near Nallur Park Main Street. A person named Anand Krishnan, associated with the number 9000000088, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, CCTV, night, photograph, main street, mobile number, suspect
